to: To-saddā which chants combine with To consonant and O vowel. See original. Tipi,9,689+690+691+692.
todaka: [Tuda+ṇvu] (na) CL=7 Toṭa(da)ka Verse which memorizes by four Sa sects.
todana: [Tuda+yu] (na) CL=7 Provoking and torture, Blame. See - Sannitodaka.
todeyya: [Tudi+ṇeyya] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who was named Todeyya, (A) One who lives in Tudi village. (B) It has a place that is Tudi village. (C) One who rules over Tudi village. (2) Todeyya Thera (who was the disciple of Bāvarī Brahmin in past).
todeyyabrāhmaṇa: [Todeyya+brāhmaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A Brahmin who was named Todeyya (who is a royal advisor of King Pasenadī kosala), A Brahmin who is a Tudi village headman.
todeyyagāma: [Todeyya+gāma] (pu) CL=7 Tudi village which is ruled over by Todeyya Brahmin. See original.
todeyyamāṇavakapucchā: [Todeyyamāṇa+pucchā] (thī) CL=7 The problem which is asked by a young man Todeyya (who is a disciple of Bāvarī Brahmin).
todeyyamāṇavakapucchāniddesa: [Todeyyamāṇavakapucchā+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 (Words (sound), Section) which express the problem which is asked by a young man Todeyya (who is a disciple of Bāvarī Brahmin) by detail and elaborate version.
todeyyapañha: [Todeyya+pañha] (ti) CL=7 The problem which is asked by a young man Todeyya (who is a disciple of Bāvarī Brahmin).
todeyyaputta: [Todeyya+putta] (pu) CL=7 The son of a Brahmin who was named Todeyya (who is a royal advisor of King Pasenadī kosala)
todeyyasutta: [Todeyya+sutta] (na) CL=7 Todeyya sutta, A sutta that preaches to a young man Deyya who is a disciple of Brahmin Bāvarī that is, An Arahant person who is already free from craving and vicikicchā and those people is without liberation "Vimokkha" except Arahattaphala, and Nibbāna, that Arahant person is called Muni.
toha: [Tuha+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 A tree that is a kind of large palm-yielding hardwood Caryota mitis.
tolakavihāra: [Tolaka+vihāra] (pu) CL=7 A monastery that was named Tolaka. See original.
tomara: [Tuda+ara] (pu,na) CL=7 [Hatthino pādevijjhanakaṇṭako "tomaro" tyu"ccate. Tujjateneneti tomaro, tuda byathane, aro, dassa mo, ottaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 366.] (1) Two-pronged spear which has halt (that is for Piercing and lacerating the legs of an elephant). See original.
tomarahattha: [Tomara+hattha] (ti) CL=7 One who holds a two-pronged spear which has halt (that is for piercing and lacerating the legs of an elephant).
tomaraṅkusapāṇi: [Tomara+aṅkusa+pāṇi] (ti) CL=7 One who holds a two-pronged spear that has halt (that is a cause of piercing and lacerating the legs of an elephant) (and) an iron cudgel (that is a cause of piercing and lacerating the head of an elephant).
tombalanāgapabbata: [Tombalanāga+pabbata] (pu) CL=7 A mountain that was called Tombalanāga (which is situated in Rohaṇa village,  Sīhaḷa Island).
tondriya: [Yadicchānāma] (pu) CL=7 (Damiḷa Leader who is a military officer) who was named Tondriya.
toraṇa: [Tura+yu] (pu,na) CL=7 [Thu+raṇa+a. Turanti vārenti etenāti toraṇaṃ, turavāraṇeti dhātu. Eka-nipāta, kākajāta, ṭī. Pe. Upari mālādiyuttaṃ sobhanathambhadvayamubhayato nikhanitvā yaṃ bahidvāraṃ kappīyate, taṃ toraṇaṃ. Tura vāraṇe, yu. Thavantā vā raṇantyatrāti toraṇaṃ. Thu abhitthave, raṇa saddattho, vaṇṇavikāro. Dhāna, ṭī. 205.] (1) Toril, the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction, Arched entrance or gate that is bow shape. See also - Toraṇūpapanna-(1). (A) The gate of the city wall which is marked by that shape. (C) The door frame which is marked by that status or arched shape. (D) Toril (the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction) which is ornamented at the left side and right side of the gate door.  See also - Toraṇamatthaka. (2) A flag mast (or) flagstaff which sets up downtown. (3) (Cakkalakkhaṇa) which is like a Toril, the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction. See original.
toraṇagga: [Toraṇa+agga] (na) CL=7 The tip of Toril (the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction). See - Toraṇamagga.
toraṇamagga: [Toraṇa+agga] (na) CL=7 The tip of Toril (the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction).
toraṇamatthaka: [Toraṇa+matthaka] (pu,na) CL=7 Above a Toril (the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction).
toraṇanivāsī: [Toraṇa+nivāsī] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī nivāsinī] One who lives in a Toril (the ornamental gateway of post and lintel construction).
toraṇavatthu: [Toraṇa+vatthu] (na) CL=7 (The place) which was named Toraṇavatthu.
toraṇūpapanna: [Toraṇa+upapanna] (ti) CL=7 (1) Arched entrance or gate which is a mysterious treasure arched gate (which is ornamented with garland and art of making items cast from bronze, copper, etc.,). (2) (A Mansion, etc.,) that is completed with a tiered roof and arched entrance (which is many levels and that is mysterious).
tosadda: [To+sadda] (pu) CL=7 To - saddā, To - paccaya. See - To (2).
tosaka: [Tusa+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 One who makes to be delightful and joyful.
tosana: [Tusa+ṇe+yu.(topaṇa-saṃ)] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) It is making to be clear and delightful. (2) To be joyful. (Ti) (3) (Precepts, etc.,) which makes to be delightful and joyful. See original.
tosanattha: [Tosana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The Benefits which can be satisfied.
tosayanta: [Tusa+ṇaya+anta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who makes (other) to be delightful and joyful. (2) One who desires to be delightful and joyful.
tosayissati: [Tusa+ṇaya+ssati] (kā,kri) CL=7 It will be made delightful. See - Toseti.
tosayissāmi: [Tusa+ṇaya+ssāmi] (kā,kri) CL=7 It will be a delight. See - Toseti.
tosayiṃ: [Tusa+ṇaya+iṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 It makes him be delighted. See -  Toseti.
tosayī: [Tusa+ṇaya+ī] (kā,kri) CL=7 It makes him be delighted. See - Toseti.
tosemi: [Tusa+ṇe+mi] (kā,kri) CL=7 (A) I make to be delightful. See - Toseti.
tosenta: [Tusa+ṇe+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī tosentī] One who makes fresh and joyful.
tosenti: [Tusa+ṇe+anti] (kā,kri) CL=7 (A) They are delighted. See - Toseti. (B) They feel pleasure. See - Toseti-(C). (C) They are fresh. See - Toseti-(D). (D) They fulfilled. See - Toseti-(F).
tosentu: [Tusa+ṇe+antu] (kā,kri) CL=7 They will be enjoyed. See - Toseti.
tosesi: [Tusa+ṇe+si] (kā,kri) CL=7 It can be enjoyed. See - Toseti. Tosesi(kā,kri) [tusa+ṇe+ī] (A) It makes to be a delight. See - Toseti. (B) It makes me be delightful and satisfied. See - Toseti. (C) It makes to be clear. See - Toseti. (D) It makes me be joyful. See - Toseti. (E) It makes me to be cherished. See- Toseti-(E).
tosessati: [Tusa+ṇe+ssati] (kā,kri) CL=7 It will be delightful. See - Toseti.
tosessāmi: [Tusa+ṇe+ssāmi] (kā,kri) CL=7 It makes you be delighted.  See - Toseti.
tosesuṃ: [Tusa+ṇe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 They are delighted. They are cleaned. See - Toseti-(B).
tosetabba: [Tusa+ṇe+tabba] (ti) CL=7 One who makes them be delightful.
toseti: [Tusa+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 240.] It makes to enjoy, (A) It makes to be satisfied. (C) It makes to be enjoyed. (D) It makes to be fresh. (E) It makes to be fulfilled. (F) It makes to be a delight. (G) It makes to be satisfied.
tosetukāma: [Tosetuṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 One who desires to enjoy. See - Tosayanta-(2).
tosetuṃ: [Tusa+ṇe+tuṃ] (kā,kri,vi) CL=7 To be enjoyable and fresh.
toseyya: [Tusa+ṇe+eyya] (kā,kri) CL=7 (A) It should be enjoyed. See - Toseti. (B) It should be delighted. See - Toseti-(G).
[Tusa+ṇe+eyyaṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 It shall be satisfying. See - Toseti-(H).
toseyyaṃ: [Tusa+ṇe+eyyaṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 It shall be satisfying. See - Toseti-(H).
tosita: [Tusa+ṇe+ta] (ti) CL=7 One who can be pleased.
toya: [Tā+ya] (na) CL=7 [Tāyate pālayateti toyaṃ, tā pālane, curādi, yo, ākārassettaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 661.] Water, Flowing water.
toyada: [Toya+dā+a] (pu,na) CL=7 [Toyaṃ dadātīti toyado. Vācappati.] The cloud which (can be given water).
toyadullabha: [Toya+dullabha] (ti) CL=7 There is poor water (not much water), It is difficult to get water, Difficult to get water (or) Hard to obtain water (Arid). See - Toyadullabhakāla.
toyadullabhakāla: [Toyadullabha+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period when it gets water that is difficult to get, When it is hard to obtain water.
toyaga: [Toya+gamu+kvi] (ti) CL=7 (Palm leaf, etc.,) that is floating in the flowing water.
toyalavāsitta: [Toya+lava+āsitta] (ti) CL=7 One who is pouring with drops of water.
toyamajjha: [Toya+majjha] (na) CL=7 (The place) where is in the middle of water.
toyavāpī: [Toya+vāpī] (thī) CL=7 A lake which was called Toya, Toya Lake. See original.
toyābhisecanakara: [Toya+abhisecana+kara] (ti) CL=7 One who can be made pouring water himself.
toādesa: [To+ādesa] (pu) CL=7 (Kāriya) it should point out that is a forest, A Forest. See - To-(1).
toṇḍamānāyaravhaya: [Toṇḍamānāyara+avhaya] (pu) CL=7 (Damiḷa military officer) who was named Toṇḍamānāyara. See also - Toṇḍamānāyaravhaye.
toṇḍi: [Toṇḍa+i] (pu) CL=7 (Damiḷa Region that is situated in the southern of Indiya) which was named Toṇḍi.
toṭaka: [Tuda+ṇvu] (na) CL=7 Toṭa(da)ka verse (which should be memorized by four Sa sects).
tosayi: [Tusa+ṇaya+iṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 It makes him be delighted. See -  Toseti.
tosesu: [Tusa+ṇe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 They are delighted. They are cleaned. See - Toseti-(B).
tosetu: [Tusa+ṇe+tuṃ] (kā,kri,vi) CL=7 To be enjoyable and fresh.
